name: Software development
summary: We design and build reliable software around the way your business actually works. From websites and customer-facing platforms to internal systems, business applications, APIs, and custom tools, we take projects from idea and requirements through development, testing, deployment, and handover.
includes: Websites, web applications, SaaS platforms, and customer portals
Internal business applications, dashboards, and custom tools
REST APIs, backend systems, databases, and third-party integrations
Authentication, user management, payments, notifications, and business workflows
Modernising legacy applications and replacing spreadsheet-based processes
Cloud deployment, performance optimisation, monitoring, and technical documentation

name: AI solutions
summary: We turn AI from an experiment into something your team can actually use. We identify where AI can create measurable value, select the right models and approach, and build the applications, workflows, safeguards, and evaluation needed to put it into production.
includes: AI assistants, copilots, and intelligent business applications
LLM integrations and AI-powered features inside existing software
Document processing, extraction, classification, and summarisation
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge-based systems
AI agents and multi-step task automation
Model selection, prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring
Human-in-the-loop workflows for decisions that require oversight
AI integration with internal systems, databases, APIs, and business tools

name: AI & business automation
summary: We automate repetitive work that consumes your team's time, connecting the systems, data, and processes already in your business. The goal is not simply to remove a manual step, but to build a reliable workflow that can run consistently with the right level of human oversight.
includes: Business process discovery and workflow mapping
End-to-end workflow automation
AI-powered document and data processing
Invoice, billing, reporting, and approval automation
CRM, ERP, email, spreadsheet, and API integrations
Scheduled jobs, background processing, and event-driven workflows
Automated notifications, alerts, data synchronisation, and reporting
Human approval steps where automation should not make the final decision
Monitoring, error handling, logging, and operational handover

name: Data analytics
summary: We turn disconnected, messy, or underused data into information your team can trust and act on. From data pipelines and database design to analytics, dashboards, forecasting, and machine learning, we build the systems that make your data useful for everyday decisions.
includes: Data collection, cleaning, transformation, and integration
ETL and ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data
Data warehouses, databases, and analytical data models
Business intelligence dashboards and management reporting
Data correlation, trend analysis, and performance measurement
Forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, and predictive models
Machine learning models and analytical automation
Data quality, validation, governance, and monitoring
Analytics APIs and data services for integration into applications
Turning operational data into measurable business insights
